name: Manitou BF SA
summary: Manitou BF SA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, manufacture, and distribution of equipment and services in France, Southern Europe, Northern Europe, the Americas, Asia, the Pacific, Africa, and the Middle East. The company operates in two segments: Product and Services and Solutions.
